The climate in Ouranoupoli

Ouranoupoli is about 15 m above sea level. The warmest month is August, with an average high of 31°C; the coldest is January, when nights average 7°C. Around 610 mm of precipitation falls in a year on average, most of it in December (about 83 mm). The highest temperature in Ouranoupoli in 2015–2024 was 38°C (18 July 2024) and the lowest −2°C (9 January 2017).

Best time to visit Ouranoupoli

The most pleasant weather in Ouranoupoli is usually in May, June, September and October: average highs are between 21°C and 27°C, with up to 7 days of rain a month. In July and August it is hot, over 30°C in the afternoon on average.
